finance_by_currency.statement: SELECT CURRENCY, SUM(AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM ERP_DEMO.ERP_CONNECTOR_DEMO_V1.FINANCE_LINES WHERE COMPANY_CODE = ? GROUP BY CURRENCY ORDER BY CURRENCY

overdue_receivables.statement: SELECT CURRENCY, SUM(OUTSTANDING_AMOUNT) AS AMOUNT FROM ERP_DEMO.ERP_CONNECTOR_DEMO_V1.RECEIVABLES WHERE COMPANY_CODE = ? AND DUE_DATE < ? AND OUTSTANDING_AMOUNT > 0 AND DISPUTED = FALSE GROUP BY CURRENCY ORDER BY CURRENCY
